official_sources.title: Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification

verified_claims: The National Polygon Dataset publishes HMLR Index Polygons for England and Wales.
Title plans and registers record the general position of boundaries unless an exact boundary is determined.
An index polygon is an index showing the indicative location of a registered title and is not an exact legal boundary measurement.
Every registered title has at least one index polygon.
Each index polygon has a unique Poly_ID and is related to its registered title through Title_No.
Index polygons are mapped against OS MasterMap features where those features relate to ownership boundaries.
Ownership boundaries do not always follow mapped roads, paths, hedges or other MasterMap features.
National Polygon is linked to Title Descriptor and Title Number/UPRN datasets through title number.
INSPIRE Index Polygons are a simpler subset with identifier, creation date and last-updated date.
The polygon geometry must be a single area and lifecycle fields include INSERT, UPDATE, Vers_No and Rec_Status.
Valid record status values distinguish added, changed and deleted polygons.
Small gaps, overlaps, slivers, underlaps and technical overlaps can exist in the dataset.
Some actual overlaps represent multiple registered titles covering the same land and require application-based resolution.
No exact current Poly_ID, INSPIRE identifier or candidate polygon bytes have been read back for the three candidate seeds.
